name: Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu - § 20/1
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: ‘Reaffirms the goal of creating a “Tobacco-Free Generation” by 2040; urges the Commission to present, without further delay, a proposal for the revision of the EU’s tobacco legislation, supported by a comprehensive impact assessment in line with the Better Regulation guidelines, with scientific, evidence-based and appropriate regulatory measures related to different characteristics of tobacco and nicotine products, to adequately address tobacco, novel tobacco products and nicotine products, such as electronic cigarettes, heated tobacco products, nicotine pouches and other novel nicotine delivery systems;’
